# AgentReady Fictional Shop Demo

Fictional e-commerce data for local AgentReady toolkit demos only. No real products, transactions, or inventory.

## Public machine-readable resources
- [Public product catalog (JSON)](https://shop.example.com/agentready/catalog.json): Published product information (snapshot).
- [Public product catalog (Markdown)](https://shop.example.com/agentready/catalog.md): Concise product descriptions for agents.
- [Products JSON-LD](https://shop.example.com/agentready/products.jsonld): Schema.org product offer data (standalone artifact; must integrate in HTML to appear as page structured data).

## Important limitations
- The product catalog is a build-time snapshot, not a live inventory or transactional API.
- Checkout and payment require explicit website authentication and user approval.
- llms.txt is voluntary metadata; no external AI agent is required to consume it.
